author: Zegita
body:
I was banned for "Please be nice and make reports that are not offensive to a player". So I reported some guy called ii_Abdulaziz_ii and he had finally got hacks and I reported him by saying "/report ii_Abdulaziz_ii the bitch finally got hacks after all these months". I'm sorry if that was offensive but no mod told me it was offensive and furthermore I never did anything bad after that game.

I also reported a guy called CerdiCornio or whatever his name was for fly hacking and x-ray ask Klaypex and Pepetheassassin they agreed he was hacking and I never made any rude remarks about him.

Basically I got tempbanned for 7 days wtf now please I am begging you "Kiesto" the person who hates me and loves to ban me but I don't deserve a punishment this long allow it. I was never warned about that comment being rude because no mod messaged me if it was rude they should've just told me in private what the hell man.

Please PLEASE PLEASE give me one more chance I need to upload avicus videos so I can promote your server to other people who are interested. Just I am begging please I was foolish and an idiot for getting myself banned like that.

I'm sorry to sound like a beggar but I love avicus to bits and I PROMISE even though I have been banned before I won't do it again I'll keep my mouth shut and not say anything rude. Just PLEASE unban me you can mute me as long as I play the server that's all I care about.

I am begging you Kiesto and other mods I know I am a bit** and most people hate me but I just want to be unbanned that's IT and like I said you can mute me I just want to play :(
